scenarios.name: link called json to a package folder fails verify_release
argv:
import sys,os,tempfile,pathlib,shutil
sys.path.insert(0,".story-gate")
import sg_trust as T
d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());src=d/"rel";src.mkdir()
for f in T.runtime_files(".story-gate"):
    (src/f).parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copyfile(".story-gate/"+f,src/f)
pkg=d/"pkg";pkg.mkdir();(pkg/"__init__.py").write_text("x=1\n")
os.symlink(str(pkg),str(src/"json"))
print("links not covered by the signed release: "+", ".join(T.stray_links(src)))
scenarios.expect_output: links not covered by the signed release: json

scenarios.name: runtime_copy_check refuses the json link
argv:
import sys,os,subprocess,tempfile,pathlib
gp=os.path.abspath(".story-gate/gate.py");d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
env=dict(os.environ,STORY_GATE_ROOT=d)
subprocess.run(["git","init","-q","-b","main","."],cwd=d)
sd=pathlib.Path(d)/".story-gate";sd.mkdir()
pkg=pathlib.Path(d)/"pkg";pkg.mkdir();(pkg/"__init__.py").write_text("x=1\n")
os.symlink(str(pkg),str(sd/"json"))
subprocess.run(["git","-c","user.name=t","-c","user.email=t@t","commit","-q","--allow-empty","-m","i"],cwd=d)
code="import sys;sys.path.insert(0,%r);import gate as g,sg_trust as T;T.verify_release=lambda s,*a,**k:{\"version\":\"1\",\"files\":{}};print(g.runtime_copy_check([\".story-gate/json\"],\"main\")[0])"%os.path.dirname(gp)
print(subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-c",code],cwd=d,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)
scenarios.expect_output: has links the signed release doesn.t list.*json
